page.summary: Earn a grenade through repairs, prepare near a likely pickup, and attempt the save only while you can reach the right position.

verdict.recommendation: Use this as a repair-to-save option when a nearby pickup offers a real opening.
verdict.soloQ: Take saves you can read from your own position. Crossing the map after a down usually abandons repair for a window you cannot reach.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Call that the grenade is ready and agree who approaches the pickup, so the rest of the team keeps working.
verdict.mainWeakness: Preparation and close positioning cost time even when the Killer never offers a usable pickup.

plans.label: Crafted save tool
plans.why: This defines only the grenade tool. Choose the remaining slots for your wider game plan; the research does not establish a fixed four-perk build.

choices.whyItsHere: Make repair work prepare a later save, so you can contribute before the pickup opportunity instead of waiting beside every chase.

mechanics.explanation: A crafted grenade is the resource for the close-range save attempt. Having charged the perk is preparation; confirm that you have actually crafted the grenade before leaving to intercept.

activationWhen: You have Flashbang equipped and can contribute useful repair work to prepare a grenade for a later save opportunity.

steps.label: Repair before hunting a save
instructions: Work on a useful generator until your own repair contribution readies Flashbang. Keep repairing if no worthwhile save is developing; do not wait idle for a teammate to go down.

steps.label: Prepare the grenade
instructions: When the perk is ready and a locker detour is safe, enter the locker and use the crafting action. Confirm the grenade is ready to use before taking the saver position.

steps.label: Read the down and approach
instructions: Watch where the teammate falls and where the Killer would stand to pick them up. Approach only if that geometry gives you access to a close drop position and an exit; do not start a long chase behind the Killer just to prove the save can work.
With voice communication, call your approach and let other teammates keep their jobs. Without it, avoid duplicating a saver who is already in position.

steps.label: Commit to the pickup window
instructions: Use the pickup commitment to judge the grenade drop so its blast meets the save window. Read the Killer's position and facing rather than dropping automatically when a teammate goes down.
If the Killer repositions or denies your approach, hold the resource and leave instead of throwing it at the old location.

steps.label: Clear the area and reassess
instructions: After the attempt, get out of the Killer's immediate pressure. If the teammate was freed, give them room to escape; if the save failed, reassess the hook rescue rather than chasing an expired pickup window.

abortWhen: The pickup is already beyond your reachable save window, the Killer changes position so the drop is no longer useful, or approaching would give up your own safe exit.
The Killer leaves the teammate down and threatens the waiting saver. Return to useful work or reassess recovery instead of hovering indefinitely.
afterSuccess: Return to repair when the immediate danger is over. Further saves need fresh preparation; do not assume the spent grenade is still available.

weaknesses: The grenade takes objective work and a crafting detour to prepare; a ready resource still needs a suitable pickup position and timing.
killerCounterplay: The Killer can change facing or position, delay the pickup, or punish a Survivor waiting close to the down.
commonMistakes: Leaving a generator to intercept with a charged perk but no crafted grenade.
Dropping at the down rather than reading the actual pickup and blast window.
Hovering through repeated denied pickups while nobody advances the generators.

soloQ: Use nearby opportunities you can verify; an injured teammate's route is not a promise that they will fall in your save position.
coordinatedSwf: Call readiness and intended approach, then cancel the attempt explicitly if the Killer denies it so another teammate can plan the rescue.
